meta.title: GRN Approval Workflow: refused for a user without the Warehouse Manager role
gaps: Open or configure GRN Approval Workflow and set value or quantity approval thresholds
Sign in as a user without the Warehouse Manager role and verify the action is refused or absent
Repeat the workflow as a Warehouse Manager and verify it is available
Verify the tenant is on the Enterprise plan or inspect whether RBAC grants the action to additional roles
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open or configure GRN Approval Workflow and set value or quantity approval thresholds; Sign in as a user without the Warehouse Manager role and verify the action is refused or absent; Repeat the workflow as a Warehouse Manager and verify it is available; Verify the tenant is on the Enterprise plan or inspect whether RBAC grants the action to additional roles

args.need: sign in as a user without the Warehouse Manager role and as a Warehouse Manager on the specified Enterprise tenant, run GRN Approval Workflow with GRNs above a value or quantity threshold, and compare whether the action is refused or absent for the first user and available for the Warehouse Manager

steps.note: The catalog cannot access the GRN workflow, configure its thresholds, or switch between the required user roles.
Perform a final generic screen-health check after the tester completes or skips the unavailable workflow verification.
